name: Implement dharma-weighted priority queue with sorted sets
description: Implement community support queue using Valkey sorted sets. Score = BaseUrgency × DharmaScore × MatchRelevance × RecencyOfContribution. ZRANGEBYSCORE for dequeuing, ZINCRBY for dharma adjustments. Implement due-time wheel for timed obligations with score = Unix timestamp. This task covers sorted-set mechanics — it does not claim end-to-end work queue correctness, which requires the durable-first scheduler promotion task.
